label: offer/promise constructions
explanation: This feature fires on the lexemes offer and promise (offer, offers, offered, offering, promise, promises, promised, promising) and on the function words immediately following them in their complement frame (to, a, of, him, me, the, on, buy). It fires most strongly on the head words themselves, especially promise forms which are almost always active, while adjacent function words and occasional unrelated tokens are weaker spillover. It does not fire on ordinary uses of “to” or “a” or on other verbs.
